purpose: Additive per-country opening game scenario. Factory and opening stock quantities are simulation-only values, not claims about current real-world installed factories, inventory, mines, output or geological reserves.

invariants.factories: Permanent, unique built asset IDs. Never expire with supply contracts. Existing assets are preserved and IDs are deduplicated.
invariants.stocks: Finite, consumable inventory. Initialized once. No silent refill at Day 100 and no inventory inferred from geological endowment.
invariants.mines: A source site record is not a built mine. Runtime only commissions unique eligible site records with a canonical resource, positive reserve and positive daily capacity.
invariants.evidence: Opening assets/stocks are explicitly simulation-only. They never rewrite source site status, reserve evidence or measured production.
invariants.catalog: Only the existing 21 factory profiles, existing recipe rules and existing 41 resource IDs are used.

countRule.missingData: One scenario starter factory is granted; missing country statistics remain null and do not imply a reported factory count.
